errors.says: The total dimension L lost on decreasing edges is L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539, 'below N/2'.
errors.paper: The ratios L/N are 100/539 and 101/539, 'both smaller than 1/2' (equivalently L<N/2, line 895); the plan mixes the ratio with the bound on L.

errors.says: The multiplication algorithm obtains the exact 2n-bit product 'in O(Tp) steps beyond the layer costs'.
errors.paper: Besides the layers, the algorithm pays the Gaussian line maps O(dTp^{3/2+delta}alpha), CRT and axis layouts O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)), chunk exchanges O(Tp pK^{tau-1}), chirps O(Tdp^{1+delta}) and packed products O(Tp log(rp)), none of which is O(Tp) (Table tab:costs and its justification).

errors.says: At a node with e=m^k chunks, 'the s children plus binary basis changes, scalar gates, endpoint corrections and reassembly cost O(V((eK)^tau+1)) at that node'.
errors.paper: The O(V((eK)^tau+1)) bound covers only the node's own work (basis changes, inverses, scalar gates, endpoint corrections, reassembly); the s recursive calls are charged separately as s(V/W)F(e/m) in the recurrence. The plan's wording can be read as folding the children into the overhead.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route all the way to the main bound: scalar exchange network, frames, nested labels and the budget Wm-2N+2L, the two interfaces with s<Wm, the explicit exponent tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}, the interchange recurrence and its width extension, phase frames plus packed selected-bit additions giving the layer recurrence and the O(Vd^{lambda'}) layer, then synthetic transforms, ring convolution, resampling with retained permutations, chirp and permutation cancellation, the algorithm, exact recovery and the cost table with margin 2kappa. It thins only at the leaves: the stream primitives (S2, S3) are stated without derivation, the conjecture's refutation logic is only alluded to, and the S8 umbrella misstates the non-layer cost as O(Tp), a slip that S9 corrects.

steps.note: h=100, v=binom(h,3), N=v^3, m=h^3, banks X_a,Y_a over T^3, the three stages and the exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) restoring every scratch wire are all stated.
Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise gate, implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and edges costing only D_vD_u^{-1} are all present.
Nondegenerate subspace labels in F^{⊗3} of dimension m, comparable labels on every edge, and the central 3->4 edges as the only decreasing ones, each losing h, are stated.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change are given.
L=Ich, sum of |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L by telescoping, and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are stated.
L/N=100/539 and 101/539 below 1/2, the extra N source ranks, and the strict s<Wm (deficit 2N-2L_c explicitly, N-2L_b implicit in s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b<W_bm) are present.
M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m on every role, checked as P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m, giving the shear H<-H+D on every row including scratch rows.
Shear by a rank-a matrix via E_1 Pi E_2 with exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each interchange a recursive call, totalling s calls per node.
Children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau) are all stated.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the whole central chain with its defining content: the h=100 bank-exchange network, frames, nested labels with the single decreasing central edge, rank equal to dimension change with the N source exceptions, the budget Wm-N+2L, the ratio L/N<1/2 giving s<Wm, the endpoint identity, edges as s recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. All nine steps are reconstructed.
